type Branch = {kind:'a'; a: string} | {kind:'b'; b: number};
function declared(x: Branch) {
  const {kind, ...rest} = x;
  console.log(rest.a, rest.b);
  const {a = 'a'} = rest;
  const copy = {...rest};
  console.log(copy.a);
  const array = [rest];
  console.log(array[0].b);
  if (kind === 'a') console.log(rest.a);
}
function conditional(flag: boolean) {
  const {drop, ...rest} = flag ? {drop: 1, a: 'x'} : {drop: 2, b: 1};
  console.log(rest.a, rest.b);
  const item = flag ? {drop: 1, a: 'x'} : {drop: 2, b: 1};
  const {drop: other, ...fromVariable} = item;
  console.log(fromVariable.a, fromVariable.b);
  const spread = flag ? {...rest} : {a: 'a'};
  console.log(spread.b);
}
function assigned(x: Branch) {
  let rest: {a: string} | {b: number};
  let tag: Branch['kind'];
  ({kind: tag, ...rest} = x);
  console.log(rest.b);
}
function indexObject(x: {ignored: string; val: number}) {
  const {ignored, ...rest} = x;
  const index: Record<string, number> = rest;
  console.log(index.val);
}
function f(x: { kind: 'a'; value: 'yes'; other: 4 } | { kind: 'b'; value: 'no'; other: 4 }) {
  const { kind, ...rest } = x;
  const literal: 'yes' | 'no' = rest.value;
  const num: 4 = rest.other;
}
